ai.description: *Amolops aniqiaoensis* is a 3–4 cm frog with a green-spotted brown dorsum and white belly. It features a distinct white upper lip stripe and granular skin on its flanks.
ai.identificationRemarks: *Amolops aniqiaoensis* is best distinguished by the presence of a distinct, continuous dorsolateral fold, which is absent or fragmented in most similar Indian torrent frogs.
ai.habitat: The Aniqiao Torrent Frog inhabits high-altitude, fast-flowing mountain streams within subtropical evergreen forests, typically found at elevations between 1,500 and 2,000 meters.
ai.behavior: The Aniqiao Torrent Frog is primarily nocturnal, remaining active at night to forage for small invertebrates along the rocky, fast-flowing streams it inhabits.
ai.reproductionNotes: *Amolops aniqiaoensis* is an oviparous species that breeds during the monsoon season (June–August), laying eggs in clutches attached to submerged rocks in torrents.
ai.distributionRemarks: *Amolops aniqiaoensis* is found in the Eastern Himalayas of Arunachal Pradesh, India, typically inhabiting high-elevation mountain streams.
ai.callDescription: The Aniqiao Torrent Frog produces a series of high-pitched, piercing whistles that cut through the loud, rushing water of its rocky mountain stream habitat.
